# Mac targets, built only with a Retro68 toolchain (see scripts/build-mac.sh).
#
# Milestone 1: JitterbugCollector - an ordinary application that records raw
# timing samples to a .jbr trace on the real B&W. No INIT, no patching, nothing
# installed system-wide, so it is safe to iterate on via LaunchAPPL.
#
# Milestone 3: the Jitterbug system extension, a 68K INIT (Retro68 builds code
# resources only for 68K; PowerPC Macs run it under the 68K emulator). Apps
# reach it through mac/sdk (Gestalt 'JBug'); JitterbugTest exercises that.

# Icons are generated by resources/icon/make_icons.py; collector.r binds them
# to this creator code so the Finder shows them.
add_application(JitterbugCollector
    CREATOR JtBg
    collector/collector.c
    collector/collector.r
    resources/JitterbugIcons.r)

target_link_libraries(JitterbugCollector jbcore m)
set_target_properties(JitterbugCollector PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_EXTENSIONS ON)

add_application(JitterbugTest
    CREATOR JtBg
    jbtest/jbtest.c
    sdk/JitterbugGlue.c
    collector/collector.r
    resources/JitterbugIcons.r)
target_include_directories(JitterbugTest PRIVATE sdk)
set_target_properties(JitterbugTest PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_EXTENSIONS ON)

# A push-button demo of the SDK for people integrating Jitterbug into an app.
add_application(JitterbugDemo
    CREATOR JtBg
    demo/demo.c
    sdk/JitterbugGlue.c
    collector/collector.r
    resources/JitterbugIcons.r)
target_include_directories(JitterbugDemo PRIVATE sdk)
set_target_properties(JitterbugDemo PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_EXTENSIONS ON)

# Retro68 never sets the Finder's bundle bit, without which the BNDL (and so
# the icon) is ignored.
find_program(JB_PYTHON3 NAMES python3 python)
if(NOT JB_PYTHON3)
    message(WARNING "python3 not found: Jitterbug files will show generic icons")
endif()
function(jb_set_bundle_bit target name)
    if(JB_PYTHON3)
        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${JB_PYTHON3} ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/mac-set-bundle-bit.py
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} ${name}
            VERBATIM)
    endif()
endfunction()
jb_set_bundle_bit(JitterbugCollector_APPL JitterbugCollector)
jb_set_bundle_bit(JitterbugTest_APPL JitterbugTest)
jb_set_bundle_bit(JitterbugDemo_APPL JitterbugDemo)

# The extension. Same steps as Retro68's Samples/SystemExtension: link flat
# 68K code, then Rez wraps it in an 'INIT' resource with the icons.
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Retro68")
    add_executable(JitterbugINIT init/jitterbug_init.c)
    target_include_directories(JitterbugINIT PRIVATE sdk)
    target_link_libraries(JitterbugINIT jbcore m)
    set_target_properties(JitterbugINIT PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 99 C_EXTENSIONS ON
        OUTPUT_NAME JitterbugINIT.flt
        LINK_FLAGS -Wl,--mac-flat)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT Jitterbug.bin Jitterbug.dsk
        COMMAND ${REZ} -I${REZ_INCLUDE_PATH} -I${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources
                ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/init/jitterbug_init.r
                -o Jitterbug.bin --cc Jitterbug.dsk --cc Jitterbug
                -t INIT -c JtBg
        DEPENDS JitterbugINIT init/jitterbug_init.r resources/JitterbugIcons.r
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
    add_custom_target(Jitterbug_INIT ALL DEPENDS Jitterbug.bin Jitterbug.dsk)
    jb_set_bundle_bit(Jitterbug_INIT Jitterbug)
endif()
